name: cal-05-stands
version_tag: CALENDAR (shiura 7035937 Ver.2) — stand-L and stand-R with their white paint marks, FULL SIZE. Both stands share one plate deliberately: each -paint file is a tiny 3.1x2.8mm edge marker whose band sits 0-5.4mm above the bed on BOTH stands, so a single ~27-layer flush band covers both (~9g of purge). Split across two plates it would cost that twice for two 3mm dots — poor value. If purge is being counted, these marks are the first thing to drop; the stands work without them. REGISTRATION: the paint delta is [+52.928, +9.588] on BOTH stands — a genuine near-rim offset, not an error, since the marker sits at r~53 of a 54.6 radius part. z_offset is 0 for both (stand-L base and paint share min-z 11.30; stand-R shares -16.70). LAYOUT: the first attempt put stand-L at [70,70] and was refused — at 109.2mm wide its bbox reached x15.4/y15.4 and clipped the P1S front-left exclusion zone X[0,18] Y[0,28]. Both stands now sit at y140, which clears the zone on Y regardless of X, side by side at x67 and x188 for an 11.8mm gap. Do not drift these back toward the origin. SPEEDS: stock 0.20mm Standard. FILAMENT: slot 1 black PLA MATTE, slot 2 white PLA BASIC, ams_mapping 2,0.
